name: lfad
description: A dashboard for agent work that uses a folder in your project as the source of truth. Each ticket an agent works on keeps a self-contained folder of markdown notes and screenshots, so you can review the work and remember what was done.

interface.shortDescription: Review agent work as markdown notes and screenshots, kept in your project folder.
interface.longDescription: Set up and open a local dashboard that reads a folder in your project. Each ticket an agent works on gets a self-contained folder of markdown notes and screenshots as it moves through research, interview, design, build and review, so you can review the work and remember what was done.
defaultPrompt: Set up the agent dashboard for this project.
